name: InstaDemo
description: InstaDemo clones a web page into an interactive, clickable product tour with AI-written tooltips. This connector lets Claude create new demos from a URL, list your existing demos, and pull view/lead performance stats — all on your signed-in InstaDemo account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add InstaDemo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add InstaDemo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tryinstademo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the InstaDemo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: InstaDemo provides these MCP tools: create_demo, get_demo, get_demo_analytics, and list_demos.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to InstaDemo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to InstaDemo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
InstaDemo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
InstaDemo is developed by InstaDemo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
